title: A vapour pressure fit inside its range

scenes.say: This vapour pressure fit for water is 0.47 K off, inside its own valid range.
The Antoine equation: three fitted constants per liquid.

scenes.note: my code raises an error outside it
scenes.say: Each fit comes with a temperature range, and my simulator raises an error outside it.
Water is left out: NIST's water fits end at 373 K, and water boils at 373.17 K.
Inside their ranges, against the IAPWS reference: one fit is 0.025 K high, the other 0.47 K.

scenes.note: it says where, not how well
scenes.say: A range check accepts both. It says where a fit may be used, not how good it is there.
